missing: Measured container performance on sub-$500 Intel boxes: Immich import/ML job times, Home Assistant responsiveness, RAM headroom and idle power with several containers running, plus current prices and the cost of the RAM upgrade most picks need.
why: No major reviewer or authority appears. Four niche sites (homelabpicks, bitdoze, starryhope, theitfeed) answer with specs and prices but admit or show no testing; several converge on the UGREEN DXP2800 without measuring it. The rest are over-budget picks (DS425+, DXP4800 Plus, DS923+), general guides, or recycled-domain listicles with unverifiable testing claims. A focused sub-$500 Docker/Immich/Home Assistant comparison with current prices, RAM-upgrade costs and a direct pick would stand out.
